page_summary:
The VALIS Trilogy is the canonical works record for PKD's novel. It gathers 2 archive manifestations under one bibliographic heading so edition history, duplication, adaptation, or later republication can be read together. The manifestations span 2 novels. Visible examples include The VALIS Trilogy (1981–1982 (Mariner Books edition 2011)), The VALIS Trilogy (2011). The longest manifestation in the set runs 543 pages.
